text: The auto-commit button now shows the next scheduled commit time (e.g. "next 02:03 PM"), and its tooltip gives the last commit's time, ID and file count. A first version cut the time string short and dropped AM/PM, so it now uses the locale's format (14:03 on 24-hour setups). The engine was restarted to load the change and auto-commit was re-enabled, producing commit 9b6cf18 (7 files) with the next run due at 14:03; engine tests, typecheck and build pass, split across three commits ending at c238968.
